about: Feature modules for roms/p30-skeleton.asm (layout 2.0). A module is code in the skeleton's free space plus a jump written over one of the hook slots at 7F00h; see roms/p30-skeleton.md. The app keeps the checksum byte (7FFFh) balanced when it applies or removes one.

features.name: Shift light on the check-engine lamp
features.description: Lights the dash check-engine lamp (P1.4) above 6000 rpm. Hook: hook_main (7F03h). Code: 7E00h-7E0Eh. RAM: none.
features.verified: Simulator, P30 skeleton 2.0: lamp off at 2500 rpm, on at 6500 and 8600 rpm; nothing else changes.
